employee_number: ---IMPORT INSTRUCTIONS (delete this section before importing)---
FIELD DEFINITIONS:
- employee_number: Your employee ID (must match employees import)
- date: Date (YYYY-MM-DD format)
- is_available: true | false
- preferred_shift: day | swing | night | split | any
- start_time: Earliest available time (HH:MM in 24-hour format)
- end_time: Latest available time (HH:MM in 24-hour format)
- notes: Additional notes or reason if unavailable
SHIFT TYPES:
- split: Multiple shifts in one day
- any: Flexible
HOW TO USE:
1. Enter your employee_number in each row
2. Add a row for each date in the period
3. Set is_available to false for blackout dates
4. Delete this instruction section before importing
5. Import via ATLVS > Settings > Data Import > Availability
